protocol.purpose: Exploratory per-condition repeat and rotation sensitivity diagnostics, not replacement verification or promotion
protocol.ordering: Case order fixed; baseline forward then AD; for each epsilon alternate plus-minus and minus-plus by repeat index; two baseline forward repeats after sweep.
protocol.summary: Median losses, actual float32 control denominators, min/max derivative envelope from repeated plus/minus losses, empirical per-condition ranges and median AD discrepancies. Ranges and envelopes are not statistical confidence bounds. No automatic pass/fail gate.
protocol.reset_check: Hash exported physical state immediately after reset and pose application for every run; hash source initial-state template before and after. Does not verify every internal simulator field.
protocol.branch_diagnostic: Final active MILK displacement relative to upstream first-step reference: per-axis positive/negative/exact-zero and abs(delta)<1e-6 counts. Not a contact counter or proof of branch crossing.
protocol.scope: Original max_loss_steps remains 1000, temporal sum is four/eight steps; terminal attraction excluded. No terminal test, optimizer or source equation changes. Existing failed gate stays unchanged.
